turns.notes: The title screen shows a NOCK AN ARROW start button, the archer at the bottom left, 20 arrows and a 1500 target. Clicking start, capturing the field, then trying one held draw-and-release shot toward the middle of the sky.

The first shot was a weak draw: the arrow arced low toward x480 and missed the balloons, so the score is still 0. Next I fire three shots with longer 2s draws aimed above the rising balloons, capturing one frame mid-draw to see the power cue.

The score went to 50 after a hit with a +50 popup, and the second frame shows a mid-draw power ring with about 17 arrows left. I release the held shot, then try fast clicks to see whether quick shots fire and use up arrows faster on the way to the end of the game.

Score is 50 and about 17 arrows are left, but the five quick clicks fired nothing, so a shot seems to need a held draw. To get through the quiver faster I test whether a held Space key shoots, then make three held 1.4s mouse draws aimed above the rising pink and yellow balloons.

The score jumped from 50 to 350 with a +300 popup, so a multi-pop or combo shot landed, and about 13 arrows are left. This is the last turn, so I fire four more held draws aimed above the pink and purple balloons to use up arrows toward the end of the game.
